D9, DM-34. The eyeCup stage steps from vesicle to cup inside the eye record; cup outerDiameterMm = vesicle diameter, depthMm = 0.6 x diameter; the alias chain names optic vesicle (11.66 to 19 hpf) and optic cup (19 to 24 hpf).

D9. Retina, lens and retinal pigmented epithelium by part of eyeCup (BG-36); lens volume 10 percent of the cup volume at 24 hpf; the eye's own mesh ends at 30 hpf. The RPE fade-in of 12 h is the pigmentation ramp (24 to 36 hpf).

D9. earVesicle with canals.present true from 72 hpf; loop diameter from the pillar length at 66 hpf. The inner ear keeps its ZFA start of 19 hpf (DM-33, E034) and is drawn from 19 to 66 hpf as the endolymph space inside the otic vesicle lumen; the vesicle shell fades out over the window and the inner ear grows to the full ear.
D9 develops-from row (16 to 18 hpf; spec 4.8 wrote 16 to 19). Cavitation at 18 to 19 hpf (Haddon and Lewis 1996).
